step.act1_prison.completion_flavor: The data stream ends before it becomes a translation. No language, no mathematics, and no human model can hold the whole of it. But the archive is not random: routes, containment records, warnings, and fragments of an identity are buried together in the noise. The cell was built for something. It is empty now. And the terminal has sent the first answer back into the dark.
step.act1_prison.description: The door has opened onto a facility built beneath Mars. Descend through the silent prison, restore the systems that still answer, and reach the deep cell at the bottom. The cell is empty, but one terminal is alive. Extract its data; it may tell you whether the prisoner left by choice, by force, or long before anyone on Mars knew this place existed.
step.act1_prison.ready_message: The archive handoff is ready. Take the recovered archive to the Research Officer at Alpha Centauri's Science Port for an independent reading. The work will wait for you; the signal will not become clearer on its own.
step.act1_prison.title: The Prison Below
step.epilogue_reward_bar.completion_flav: The old man spends an evening in your hold with a cargo strap and a marker. A tenth of every hull you ever fly is now space no scanner reads.
step.epilogue_reward_bar.description: Return to the Barkeep on Earth and share the data archive.
step.epilogue_reward_bar.dialogue.barkee: Can't believe you survived all that. You had the whole militia's full force hunting you down. We've got a use for people like you... But you need to level up your game. There are ways to conceal your cargo from all eyes. We'll teach you what we know. From today, expect about a tenth of whatever you can carry? Completely concealed. The data archive stays between us, once we know what we got... we may contact you again.
Share the data archive, learn the tricks.
step.epilogue_reward_bar.title: The Bar's Payoff
step.epilogue_reward_lab.completion_flav: The credentials go through. Your comms light up with new work. All the labs through all the solar systems will recognize you. Somewhere in the Lab the data archive is being studied layer by layer.
step.epilogue_reward_lab.description: Return to the Research Officer at Mercury and share the data archive.
step.epilogue_reward_lab.dialogue.resear: This data is the most important research find in centuries. Leave it with us and we will treat it properly. In return: credentials into our network. Every station in the network will post you contracts - specimen runs, site recovery, etc. All at frontier rates. The work pays great. It takes a solid reference to get in, and you've definitely earned that.
Share the data archive, take the credentials
step.epilogue_reward_lab.title: The Lab's Question
step.epilogue_reward_merchants.completio: 12,000 credits paid. The Guild happily trades it for the data archive.
step.epilogue_reward_merchants.descripti: Return to the Guild Master on Earth and share the archive.
You brought back something older than every ledger we keep. The Guild will remember you held up your end of the deal. The 8,000 credits you spent will be returned, with interest.
Share the archive, collect your credits.
step.epilogue_reward_merchants.title: The Guild's Due
step.epilogue_reward_militia.completion_: Your name goes on the roster. The board at the Militia offices will have work posted for you from here on.
step.epilogue_reward_militia.description: Return to the Militia Captain on Earth and share the data archive.
step.epilogue_reward_militia.dialogue.mi: You went through that door and came back alive? You're turning into someone I can trust. I am putting you on the warrant list. Return to any Militia post starting today for good paying work. Real targets, frontier rates, and a huge pool of jobs. Leave the data archive with me and we are square.
Share the archive and shake their hand. Make the deal.
step.epilogue_reward_militia.title: The Captain's Price
step.prologue_open.description: Return to Mars. Open the door. Curiosity drives you forward.
step.prologue_open.title: The Door Opens
